clients.boto3: boto3 1.43.114, botocore 1.43.114, s3transfer 0.19.2, urllib3 2.8.0, awscrt not installed, Python 3.13.13
clients.curl: curl 8.21.0 (Windows) libcurl/8.21.0 Schannel zlib/1.3.2 WinIDN WinLDAP

config.aws_config:
[default]
region = us-east-1
s3 =
  addressing_style = path

[profile when-required]
region = us-east-1
request_checksum_calculation = when_required
response_checksum_validation = when_required
s3 =
  addressing_style = path

[profile multipart-5mb]
region = us-east-1
s3 =
  addressing_style = path
  multipart_threshold = 5MB
  multipart_chunksize = 5MB
config.boto3_prelude:
import logging, os, sys
import boto3
from botocore.config import Config
logging.basicConfig(stream=sys.stderr, format="%(asctime)s - %(threadName)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s")
logging.getLogger("botocore.auth").setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
s3 = boto3.client("s3", endpoint_url=os.environ["ENDPOINT"], config=Config(s3={"addressing_style": "path"}))
config.tls: throwaway CA via AWS_CA_BUNDLE and curl --cacert; chain and host verification on (curl --ssl-revoke-best-effort: the throwaway CA has no CRL, other curl TLS backends ignore the flag)
